译文忠实保留原文，但此重载签名接收 IClientConnectionRetryFilter，正文仍称 provided delegate，属于上游重载说明不准确。

entries.sourceText: Read-only native probe of the specified cluster's original backing state. Returns true when its membership data is deleted or its owner has terminally invalidated the store; returns false while seeded data remains. The probe runs before owner disposal, must preserve backend identity, and must propagate infrastructure failures. Persistent providers can inspect the same scope through independent backend access; terminal providers inspect native invalidation. The suite checks the probe against populated data before invoking deletion.
entries.translationBefore: 对指定集群原始后端状态进行只读原生探测。当其成员数据已删除，或其所有者已使存储最终失效时，返回 true；只要预置数据仍存在，就返回 false。探测在所有者释放之前运行，必须保持后端标识不变，并向上传播基础设施失败。持久化提供程序可通过独立的后端访问检查同一作用域；具有终止语义的提供程序检查原生失效状态。套件会在调用删除之前，使用已填充数据验证该探测。
entries.conclusion: 核对已删除或最终失效时 true、预置数据仍在时 false，以及释放前探测、后端标识和异常传播约束，译文完整。

entries.sourceText: Attempts to a value to the dehydration context, associated with the provided key, serializing it using Serializer. If a serializer is found for the value, and the key has not already been added, then the value is added and the method returns true. If no serializer exists or the key has already been added, then the value is not added and the method returns false.
entries.translationBefore: 尝试将一个值添加到脱水上下文，与所提供的键关联，并使用 X0 X1 X2 进行序列化。如果找到该值的序列化器，且尚未添加该键，则添加此值并返回 X3。如果不存在序列化器，或者该键已被添加，则不添加此值并返回 X4。
entries.conclusion: 核对序列化器存在且键尚未添加的 AND 条件，以及缺少序列化器或键已存在的 OR 失败条件，译文准确。

entries.sourceText: Tries to get a value from the rehydration context, associated with the provided key, deserializing it using Serializer. If a serializer is found for the value, and the key is present, then the value is deserialized and the method returns true. If no serializer exists or the key has already been added, then the value is not added and the method returns false.
entries.translationBefore: 尝试从复水上下文获取与所提供的键关联的值，并使用 X0 X1 X2 进行反序列化。如果找到该值的序列化器，且该键存在，则反序列化此值并返回 X3。如果不存在序列化器，或者该键已被添加，则不添加此值并返回 X4。
entries.conclusion: 译文忠实保留原文；原文在复水获取的失败分支写成 key has already been added / value is not added，与前文键存在即成功的获取语义矛盾，属于上游文案问题。

entries.sourceText: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the silo liveness protocol is enabled (should be disabled only for testing). If a silo is suspected to be down, but this property is set to false, the suspicions will not be propagated to the system or enforced. This property is intended for use only for testing and troubleshooting. In production, liveness should always be enabled.
entries.translationBefore: 获取或设置一个值，指示是否启用 Silo 存活协议（仅应为了测试而禁用）。如果怀疑某个 Silo 已宕机，但此属性设置为 X0，则不会将该怀疑传播到系统或据此执行操作。此属性仅用于测试和故障排查。在生产环境中，应始终启用存活检测。
entries.conclusion: 核对 false 时不传播/执行故障怀疑，以及只供测试排障、生产必须启用存活检测的限制。

entries.sourceText: Gets or sets the memory utilization, expressed as a value between 0 and 100, at which load shedding begins. Note that this value is in %, so valid values range from 1 to 100, and a reasonable value is typically between 80 and 95. This value is ignored if load shedding is disabled, which is the default.
entries.translationBefore: 获取或设置开始负载卸除时的内存利用率，以 X0 到 X1 之间的值表示。注意，此值以百分比表示，因此有效值为 1 到 100，合理值通常为 80 到 95。如果禁用负载卸除，则忽略此值；默认即为禁用。
entries.conclusion: 阈值范围、合理区间与默认禁用的条件均准确；将 load shedding 统一为负载削减。
entries.translationAfter: 获取或设置开始负载削减时的内存利用率，以 X0 到 X1 之间的值表示。注意，此值以百分比表示，因此有效值为 1 到 100，合理值通常为 80 到 95。如果禁用负载削减，则忽略此值；默认即为禁用。

entries.sourceText: Gets or sets the CPU utilization, expressed as a value between 0 and 100, at which load shedding begins. Note that this value is in %, so valid values range from 1 to 100, and a reasonable value is typically between 80 and 95. This value is ignored if load shedding is disabled, which is the default.
entries.translationBefore: 获取或设置开始负载卸除时的 CPU 利用率，以 X0 到 X1 之间的值表示。注意，此值以百分比表示，因此有效值为 1 到 100，合理值通常为 80 到 95。如果禁用负载卸除，则忽略此值；默认即为禁用。
entries.conclusion: CPU 阈值范围和禁用时忽略的条件准确；将 load shedding 统一为负载削减。
entries.translationAfter: 获取或设置开始负载削减时的 CPU 利用率，以 X0 到 X1 之间的值表示。注意，此值以百分比表示，因此有效值为 1 到 100，合理值通常为 80 到 95。如果禁用负载削减，则忽略此值；默认即为禁用。

entries.sourceText: This is an advanced feature and should not be used unless the implications are fully understood. That said, allowing request interleaving allows the run-time system to perform a number of optimizations that may significantly improve the performance of your application.
entries.translationBefore: 这是一项高级功能，除非完全理解其影响，否则不应使用。允许请求交错执行，使运行时系统能够进行多项可能显著提高应用程序性能的优化。
entries.conclusion: 保留除非完全理解影响否则不应使用的限制，以及优化仅可能改善性能的限定。

entries.sourceText: Apply this attribute to a grain interface method declaration. Read-only requests can interleave with other read-only requests. Writable requests wait until all active read-only requests complete unless another interleaving policy permits them to overlap.
entries.translationBefore: 将此特性应用于 Grain 接口的方法声明。只读请求可与其他只读请求交错执行。可写请求会等待所有活动的只读请求完成，除非其他交错执行策略允许它们重叠。
entries.conclusion: 准确区分只读请求互相交错，以及可写请求必须等待、但其他交错策略可放宽的例外。

entries.sourceText: Gets or sets a value indicating whether messages should be dropped once they expire, that is if it was not delivered to the destination before it has timed out on the sender.
entries.translationBefore: 获取或设置一个值，指示是否在消息过期后将其丢弃，也就是消息在发送方超时之前未送达目标时是否将其丢弃。
entries.conclusion: 准确保留消息在发送方超时前未送达目标时才属过期的定义。

entries.sourceText: If true, the client / silo will shut down if there is a failure; otherwise an error will be logged and the client / silo will continue to the next stage.
entries.translationBefore: 如果为 X0，发生失败时客户端/Silo 将关闭；否则会记录错误，客户端/Silo 将继续进入下一阶段。
entries.conclusion: true 时关闭客户端/Silo；否则只记录错误并进入下一阶段，两个分支未颠倒。

entries.sourceText: Whether local calls should be cancelled immediately when cancellation is signaled (false) rather than waiting for callees to acknowledge cancellation before a call is considered cancelled (true).
entries.translationBefore: 是否在收到取消信号时立即取消本地调用（X0），而不是等待被调用方确认取消后才将调用视为已取消（X1）。
entries.conclusion: false 表示立即取消本地调用，true 表示等待被调用方确认；保留此处容易误读的布尔对应关系。

entries.sourceText: Specifies whether this IGatewayListProvider ever refreshes its returned information, or always returns the same gw list. (currently only the static config based StaticGatewayListProvider is not updatable. All others are.)
entries.translationBefore: 指定此 IGatewayListProvider 是否会刷新返回的信息，还是始终返回相同的网关列表。（目前只有基于静态配置的 StaticGatewayListProvider 不可更新，其他提供程序均可更新。）
entries.conclusion: 准确保留静态配置提供程序不可更新、其余可更新的限定。

entries.sourceText: Whether data on just current active silos should be returned, or by default data for all current and previous silo instances [including those in Joining or Dead status].
entries.translationBefore: 是否只返回当前活动 Silo 的数据；默认返回所有当前和以前 Silo 实例的数据［包括处于 Joining 或 Dead 状态的实例］。
entries.conclusion: 准确区分只返回当前活动 Silo 与默认返回当前及以往实例，并保留 Joining/Dead 范围。

entries.sourceText: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable membership eviction of silos when they remain in the Joining or Created state for longer than ClusterMembershipOptions.
entries.translationBefore: 获取或设置一个值，指示当 Silo 处于 X0 或 X1 状态的时长超过 X2 时，是否启用将其从成员集合中逐出的机制。
entries.conclusion: 译文保留原文；上游把时长成员引用显示为类型 ClusterMembershipOptions，无法从此正文获知具体阈值属性，属于上游交叉引用问题。

entries.sourceText: Configures the provided TConnectionRetryFilter type as a connection retry filter, used to determine whether initial connection to the Orleans cluster should be retried after a failure.
entries.translationBefore: 将所提供的 X0 类型配置为连接重试筛选器，用于决定与 Orleans 集群的初始连接失败后是否应重试。
entries.conclusion: 保留只涉及初始连接失败之后是否重试的范围；没有扩展为所有连接操作。

entries.sourceText: Configures the provided delegate as a connection retry filter, used to determine whether initial connection to the Orleans cluster should be retried after a failure.
entries.translationBefore: 将所提供的委托配置为连接重试筛选器，用于决定与 Orleans 集群的初始连接失败后是否应重试。
entries.conclusion: 保留由委托决定初始连接失败后是否重试的语义。

entries.sourceText: enum Indicates the reason for removing activations from the directory. This influences the conditions that are applied when determining whether or not to remove an entry.
entries.translationBefore: 枚举 指示从目录中移除激活实例的原因。这会影响决定是否移除条目时应用的条件。
entries.conclusion: 保留移除原因会影响目录条目删除条件的关系。

entries.sourceText: Gets a value indicating whether callbacks scheduled by this timer are allowed to interleave execution with other timers and grain calls. Defaults to false.
entries.translationBefore: 获取一个值，指示是否允许此计时器调度的回调与其他计时器和 Grain 调用交错执行。默认为 X0。
entries.conclusion: 计时器回调是否可与其他计时器/Grain 调用交错以及 false 默认值均准确。

entries.sourceText: Providers can implement the cancellation-aware Async methods to cancel their underlying operations. The default implementations cancel the caller's wait while the tokenless operation completes, and observe any exception from that operation. Cancellation-aware RPC methods retain the existing operation aliases and serialized application arguments. Cancellation is propagated separately from those arguments.
entries.translationBefore: 提供程序可以实现支持取消的 Async 方法，以取消其底层操作。默认实现会取消调用方的等待，同时让不带令牌的操作继续完成，并观察该操作产生的任何异常。支持取消的 RPC 方法保留现有操作别名和序列化的应用程序参数。取消信号独立于这些参数传播。
entries.conclusion: 准确区分默认只取消调用方等待、底层无令牌操作继续完成，以及提供程序可实现真正取消底层操作；RPC 参数和取消传播也未混淆。

entries.sourceText: A System.TimeSpan representing the amount of time to delay before invoking the callback method specified when the IGrainTimer was constructed. Specify System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan to prevent the timer from restarting. Specify System.TimeSpan.Zero to restart the timer immediately.
entries.translationBefore: 一个 X0，表示调用构造 X1 时指定的回调方法之前的延迟时长。指定 X2 可阻止计时器重新启动。指定 X3 可立即重新启动计时器。
entries.conclusion: 准确区分 InfiniteTimeSpan 阻止重新启动与 Zero 立即重新启动。

entries.sourceText: A System.TimeSpan representing the amount of time to delay before invoking the callback method specified when the IGrainTimer was constructed. Specify System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan to prevent the timer from starting. Specify System.TimeSpan.Zero to start the timer immediately.
entries.translationBefore: 表示调用构造 X1 时指定的回调方法之前所延迟时长的 X0。指定 X2 可阻止计时器启动。指定 X3 可立即启动计时器。
entries.conclusion: 准确区分 InfiniteTimeSpan 阻止启动与 Zero 立即启动，未误写成重新启动。

entries.sourceText: Specifies the maximum amount of time allowed for the TLS/SSL handshake. This must be positive and no greater than 4,294,967,294 milliseconds (approximately 49.7 days), or System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan to disable the timeout.
entries.translationBefore: 指定 TLS/SSL 握手允许的最长时长。此值必须为正且不大于 4,294,967,294 毫秒（约 49.7 天），或者设为 X0 以禁用超时。
entries.conclusion: 正数、4,294,967,294 毫秒上限、约 49.7 天及 InfiniteTimeSpan 禁用超时均保留。

entries.sourceText: Providers implement the cancellation-aware Async methods to cancel their underlying operations. The default implementations support existing providers by cancelling the caller's wait and observing completion of the tokenless operation.
entries.translationBefore: 提供程序通过实现支持取消的 Async 方法来取消底层操作。默认实现通过取消调用方的等待并观察不带令牌的操作的完成情况，来支持现有提供程序。
entries.conclusion: 默认实现只取消等待并观察底层无令牌操作的完成，没有错误承诺底层操作被取消。

entries.sourceText: The amount of time to delay before the callback is invoked. Specify System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan to prevent the timer from starting. Specify System.TimeSpan.Zero to invoke the callback promptly.
entries.translationBefore: 调用 X0 之前的延迟时长。指定 X1 可阻止计时器启动。指定 X2 可尽快调用回调。
entries.conclusion: 保留 Zero 为尽快调用回调而非保证同步执行；InfiniteTimeSpan 阻止计时器启动。

entries.sourceText: A System.TimeSpan.Zero value means “cancel the previous setting of the Grain call and make this activation behave based on the regular Activation Garbage Collection settings”.
entries.translationBefore: 值 X0 表示“取消先前 X1 X2 X3 调用的设置，使此激活实例按照常规的激活实例垃圾回收设置运行”。
entries.conclusion: Zero 撤销此前调用设置并恢复常规激活回收规则的语义准确；上游调用链接仅显示 Grain 类型，属于原文交叉引用信息缺失。

entries.sourceText: Gets the cancellation token for this request. If the request does not accept a cancellation token, this will be System.Threading.CancellationToken.None.
entries.translationBefore: 获取此请求的取消令牌。如果请求不接受取消令牌，则其值为 X0。
entries.conclusion: 请求不接受取消令牌时返回 CancellationToken.None 的条件准确。

entries.sourceText: Gets or sets the timeout for gracefully closing a connection. If the timeout is exceeded, the connection will be forcefully closed.
entries.translationBefore: 获取或设置正常关闭连接的超时。如果超过该超时，连接将被强制关闭。
entries.conclusion: 优雅关闭超过超时才强制关闭，顺序及触发条件准确。

entries.sourceText: The time interval between invocations of the callback method specified when the timer was constructed. Specify System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan to disable periodic signaling.
entries.translationBefore: 调用构造计时器时指定的回调方法的时间间隔。指定 X0 可禁用周期性触发。
entries.conclusion: InfiniteTimeSpan 禁用周期性触发，而非禁用所有既定首次回调，译文未扩大范围。

entries.sourceText: The time interval between invocations of the callback method specified when the IGrainTimer was constructed. Specify System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan to disable periodic signaling.
entries.translationBefore: 构造 X0 时指定的回调方法的调用间隔。指定 X1 可禁用周期性触发。
entries.conclusion: 保留回调间隔和禁用周期性触发的含义。

entries.sourceText: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to extend the effective probe timeout based upon current local health degradation.
entries.translationBefore: 获取或设置一个值，指示是否根据当前本地健康状况的恶化来延长有效探测超时。
entries.conclusion: 根据本地健康退化延长有效探测超时的条件准确。

entries.sourceText: The cancellation token which indicates that the operation should be stopped promptly when it is canceled.
entries.translationBefore: 取消令牌；取消该令牌表示应尽快停止操作。
entries.conclusion: 令牌取消表示应尽快停止操作，未承诺即时完成。

entries.sourceText: The cancellation token which indicates that the operation should be aborted promptly when it is canceled.
entries.translationBefore: 取消令牌；取消该令牌表示应尽快中止操作。
entries.conclusion: 令牌取消表示应尽快中止操作，未将其改为事务提交或仅停止等待。

entries.sourceText: A token used to cancel the wait. This does not cancel the lifecycle stage itself!
entries.translationBefore: 用于取消等待的令牌。这不会取消生命周期阶段本身！
entries.conclusion: 明确取消等待不会取消生命周期阶段本身，关键否定保留。

entries.sourceText: The time interval between invocations of callback. Specify System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan to disable periodic signaling.
entries.translationBefore: 各次调用 X0 之间的时间间隔。指定 X1 可禁用周期性触发。
entries.conclusion: 保留回调之间的间隔以及 InfiniteTimeSpan 禁用周期性触发。

entries.sourceText: Gets or sets the minimum period for which dead silo entries are retained in the membership table. Cleanup removes only dead entries whose latest startup, liveness, or suspect-vote timestamp is older than this period, regardless of ClusterMembershipOptions and ClusterMembershipOptions. Retaining recent dead entries lets a silo whose membership operations are delayed or retried, such as a joining silo within ClusterMembershipOptions, observe that it was declared dead. This period should comfortably exceed ClusterMembershipOptions and expected clock skew between silos.
entries.translationBefore: 获取或设置已失效 Silo 条目在成员表中的最短保留时长。无论 X0 和 X1 如何设置，清理操作只会删除其最近启动、存活或怀疑投票时间戳距今已超过此时长的失效条目。保留最近失效的条目，可以让成员操作被延迟或重试的 Silo（例如仍处于 X2 期限内的正在加入的 Silo）观察到自己已被宣告失效。此时长应明显长于 X3 以及 Silo 之间预期的时钟偏差。
entries.conclusion: 最近时间戳、最短保留期、延迟/重试 Silo 观察死亡状态的约束准确；上游多个属性链接折叠为 ClusterMembershipOptions 类型，需作为原文问题记录。

entries.sourceText: Maximal number of successful execution attempts. AsyncExecutorWithRetries will try to re-execute the given function again if directed so by retryValueFilter . Set to -1 for unlimited number of success retries, until retryValueFilter is satisfied. Set to 0 for only one success attempt, which will cause retryValueFilter to be ignored and the given function executed only once until first success.
entries.translationBefore: 成功执行尝试的最大次数。如果 X2 指示应重试，X0 将尝试再次执行给定的 X1。设置为 X3 可不限制成功后的重试次数，直到满足 X4。设置为 X5 表示只允许一次成功尝试，此时会忽略 X6，并仅执行给定的 X7 直到首次成功。
entries.conclusion: 准确保留成功后重试、-1 无上限、0 仅一次成功以及此时忽略成功筛选器的特殊语义。

entries.sourceText: This situation is usually a transient condition. The message is likely to be accepted by this or another gateway if it is retransmitted at a later time.
entries.translationBefore: 这种情况通常是暂时的。如果稍后重新传输该消息，此网关或其他网关很可能会接受它。
entries.conclusion: 保留通常暂时、稍后重发很可能获接受的概率性描述，未升级为保证成功。

entries.sourceText: This situation is often a transient condition. The message is likely to be accepted by this grain if it is retransmitted at a later time.
entries.translationBefore: 这种情况往往是暂时的。如果稍后重新传输该消息，此 Grain 很可能会接受它。
entries.conclusion: 保留暂时故障和重发很可能获接受的限定。

entries.sourceText: Markdown This class is a convenient utility class to execute a certain asynchronous function with retries, allowing to specify custom retry filters and policies.
entries.translationBefore: X0 Markdown X1 此类是一种便捷的实用工具类，用于执行某个异步函数并进行重试，允许指定自定义重试筛选器和策略。
entries.conclusion: 准确保留异步执行、重试筛选器与策略均可定制。

entries.sourceText: Gets or sets the amount of time to wait after a failed connection attempt before retrying the connection.
entries.translationBefore: 获取或设置连接尝试失败后，重试连接之前的等待时长。
entries.conclusion: 延迟发生在连接尝试失败之后、重试之前，时间方向准确。

entries.sourceText: Specifies the maximum amount of time to wait after encountering contention during initialization before retrying.

entries.sourceText: A brief overview of ZK features used: The data is represented by a tree of nodes (similar to a file system). Every node is addressed by a path and can hold data as a byte array and has a version. When a node is created, its version is 0. Upon updates, the version is atomically incremented. An update can also be conditional on an expected current version. A transaction can hold several operations, which succeed or fail atomically. when creating a zookeeper client, one can set a base path where all operations are relative to. In this implementation: Every Orleans deployment has a node /UniqueDeploymentId Every Silo's state is saved in /UniqueDeploymentId/IP:Port@Gen Every Silo's IAmAlive is saved in /UniqueDeploymentId/IP:Port@Gen/IAmAlive IAmAlive is saved in a separate node so owner heartbeat writes preserve the membership row's version. Membership updates atomically modify the row and deployment nodes, preserving the separate heartbeat node. a node's ZK version is its ETag: the table version is the version of /UniqueDeploymentId the silo entry version is the version of /UniqueDeploymentId/IP:Port@Gen
entries.translationBefore: 所使用 ZK 功能的简要概述：数据表示为节点树（类似文件系统）。每个节点通过路径寻址，可以将数据保存为字节数组，并具有版本。节点创建时，版本为 0。更新时，版本以原子方式递增。更新也可以以预期的当前版本为条件。一个事务可以包含多个操作，这些操作以原子方式成功或失败。创建 ZooKeeper 客户端时，可以设置一个基路径，使所有操作都相对于该路径。在此实现中：每个 Orleans 部署都有一个 /UniqueDeploymentId 节点。每个 Silo 的状态保存在 /UniqueDeploymentId/IP:Port@Gen。每个 Silo 的 IAmAlive 保存在 /UniqueDeploymentId/IP:Port@Gen/IAmAlive。IAmAlive 保存在独立节点中，使所有者的心跳写入保持成员行版本不变。成员更新以原子方式修改行节点和部署节点，并保留独立的心跳节点。节点的 ZK 版本就是其 ETag：表版本是 /UniqueDeploymentId 的版本，Silo 条目版本是 /UniqueDeploymentId/IP:Port@Gen 的版本。
entries.conclusion: 逐项核对 ZooKeeper 原子版本递增、事务全成或全败、心跳独立节点不改成员行版本，以及三个路径和 ETag 映射。

entries.sourceText: Verifies that concurrent Read-then-Write transactions on the same grain cause OrleansTransactionLockUpgradeException or OrleansBrokenTransactionLockException when no exclusive lock is used. Scenario (LockUpgradeException): TX1: PerformRead → shared lock acquired TX2: PerformRead → shared lock acquired (same group) TX1: PerformUpdate → lock upgrade fails Scenario (BrokenTransactionLockException): TX1: PerformRead → shared lock acquired TX2: PerformRead → shared lock acquired (same group) TX2: PerformUpdate → upgraded, TX1 rolled back TX1: PerformUpdate → broken lock detected
entries.translationBefore: 验证在未使用排他锁时，对同一个 Grain 执行并发的先读后写事务会导致 OrleansTransactionLockUpgradeException 或 OrleansBrokenTransactionLockException。场景（LockUpgradeException）：TX1：PerformRead → 获取共享锁；TX2：PerformRead → 获取共享锁（同一组）；TX1：PerformUpdate → 锁升级失败。场景（BrokenTransactionLockException）：TX1：PerformRead → 获取共享锁；TX2：PerformRead → 获取共享锁（同一组）；TX2：PerformUpdate → 完成升级，TX1 回滚；TX1：PerformUpdate → 检测到失效的锁。
entries.conclusion: 逐步核对两种锁异常时序：TX1 升级失败，以及 TX2 升级使 TX1 回滚后 TX1 检测到失效锁；事务身份与共享/排他关系均正确。

entries.sourceText: An array indexed by tier whose populated entries contain the transaction identifiers observed by grains at that tier. A null identifier indicates that the call ran without a transaction.

entries.translationBefore: 一个任务，其结果为一致的快照，包含当前 ETag、已提交状态及序列号、事务元数据，以及按序列号排列的待处理准备记录。
entries.conclusion: 一致快照同时包含 ETag、已提交状态/序号、元数据和按序列号排序的准备记录，完整无漏项。

entries.sourceText: When non-null, advances the committed state through the prepared state with this sequence number and makes prepare records at or below that sequence obsolete.

entries.sourceText: DefunctSiloMinimumRetention Gets or sets the minimum period for which dead silo entries are retained in the membership table. Cleanup removes only dead entries whose latest startup, liveness, or suspect-vote timestamp is older than this period, regardless of ClusterMembershipOptions and ClusterMembershipOptions. Retaining recent dead entries lets a silo whose membership operations are delayed or retried, such as a joining silo within ClusterMembershipOptions, observe that it was declared dead. This period should comfortably exceed ClusterMembershipOptions and expected clock skew between silos.
entries.translationBefore: X0 获取或设置已失效 Silo 条目在成员表中的最短保留时长。无论 X1 和 X2 如何设置，清理操作只会删除其最近启动、存活或怀疑投票时间戳距今已超过此时长的失效条目。保留最近失效的条目，可以让成员操作被延迟或重试的 Silo（例如仍处于 X3 期限内的正在加入的 Silo）观察到自己已被宣告失效。此时长应明显长于 X4 以及 Silo 之间预期的时钟偏差。
entries.conclusion: 最低保留期、最近时间戳、延迟/重试 Silo 观察自己已失效的条件完整；上游多个属性引用显示为 ClusterMembershipOptions 类型。
